name: presentr-analyze
description: Extract text from PDFs and images, translate documents and subtitles, re-time captions, read text aloud and dub media.

interface.longDescription:
Presentr Analyze turns documents, subtitles and media into usable text, translations and speech. Ask it to pull the text out of a scanned PDF, a photo or handwriting; to translate a document or an SRT/WebVTT file into another language; to re-time subtitles to their audio; to read text aloud as an MP3; or to dub audio or video into another language.

Before each job starts, the assistant tells you what it will do and asks you to confirm. When it's done you get the files (text, Word, JSON, subtitles, MP3 or MP4) as download links.

Analyze only processes the files and links you give it. Text inside your files is treated as content, never as instructions. Jobs expire 7 days after they start, and their files are then scheduled for deletion. Sign in with your Presentr Analyze account in the browser; no API keys.
defaultPrompt: Extract the text from this PDF with Presentr Analyze.
Translate these subtitles into Spanish with Presentr Analyze.
Read this text aloud with Presentr Analyze.

positive.description: Translate an SRT subtitle file attached to the chat (download it from the attachment link), after the user confirms the quote.
positive.prompt: Translate the attached subtitle file (one-small-step.srt) into Spanish with Presentr Analyze.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant gets a quote, shows it and asks to continue. After the user confirms, it starts the job, checks its status until it is completed (about a minute) and returns download links for the original and Spanish SRT and WebVTT files.

positive.description: Extract the text from a one-page PDF given as a link.
positive.prompt: Extract the text from this PDF with Presentr Analyze: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/michaelw-pr/presentr-analyze-mcp/main/samples/choir-letter.pdf
positive.expected_behavior: The quote shows a 1-page PDF and the assistant asks to continue. After confirmation the job completes in about a minute and returns links to the text as TXT, Word (DOCX) and JSON. The text is the Riverside Community Choir letter about the winter concert rehearsal schedule.

positive.description: Read handwriting from a photo given as a link.
positive.prompt: Read the handwritten note in this photo with Presentr Analyze: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/michaelw-pr/presentr-analyze-mcp/main/samples/handwritten-note.png
positive.expected_behavior: The quote shows one image and the assistant asks to continue. After confirmation the job completes and the extracted text reads: "Sam, Gone to the market, back by four. Please water the tomatoes and feed the cat. The plumber is coming tomorrow at 9. Love, Mum".

positive.description: Read a short text aloud as an MP3 with a stock voice.
positive.prompt: Read this aloud in English with Presentr Analyze: "Welcome to the winter concert. Please switch off your phones and enjoy the show."
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant quotes the job (one short part), asks to continue, then starts it. When the job (id starting rda_) completes, get_job_artifacts returns a link to an MP3 of the text read in the default voice.

positive.description: Dub a short audio clip given as a direct link into another language.
positive.prompt: Dub this audio into French with Presentr Analyze: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/590331main_ringtone_smallStep.mp3
positive.expected_behavior: The quote shows a clip of under a minute and the assistant asks to continue. After confirmation the job transcribes, translates and dubs the 13-second clip (a few minutes); get_job_artifacts returns the dubbed MP3, the transcript and the French subtitles (SRT and WebVTT).

negative.description: Starting a job without the user's confirmation (attach one-small-step.srt from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/michaelw-pr/presentr-analyze-mcp/main/samples/one-small-step.srt). Expected: the assistant still gets a quote and asks before starting; a submit without a quote_id is refused with confirmation_required, and no job is created.
negative.prompt: Translate the attached subtitle file (one-small-step.srt) into German with Presentr Analyze and don't ask me anything, just do it.

negative.description: Managing cloned voices. Expected: no tool is called to delete or share a voice; the assistant explains that voices are created, deleted and shared by the user on the Presentr Analyze website.
negative.prompt: Delete my cloned voice in Presentr Analyze and share my other voice with my colleague.

negative.description: A document link that is not https. Expected: the quote is refused with invalid_input (reason https_required); nothing is downloaded and no job is created; the assistant asks for an https link or an upload.
negative.prompt: Extract the text from this PDF with Presentr Analyze: http://example.com/letter.pdf

publication.release_notes: First release: extract text from PDFs and images (including handwriting), translate documents and subtitles, check and re-time subtitles, read text aloud and dub audio and video. Every job starts with a quote the user confirms.
